title: Binary Tree Right Side View
summary: Return the value of the rightmost node at each depth, starting from the root.
statement: Return the value of the rightmost node at each depth, starting from the root. If a level has nodes only on the left, its rightmost available node still appears in the view.

examples.explanation: The deepest node is visible even though it lies in the left subtree.
An empty tree has no visible nodes.

hints: Conceptual: There is exactly one visible node at each nonempty depth.
Directional: Read levels from left to right and keep the last value from each.
Implementation: Enqueue the left child before the right child. When the current level ends, record the node you just processed.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(w) auxiliary space excluding the result, for maximum level width w.
